title: Cybersecurity Governance
description: Cybersecurity governance roles and responsibilities shall be formally defined and approved

title: Information Asset Inventory
description: Organizations shall maintain an up-to-date inventory of information and technology assets

title: Privileged Access Control
description: Privileged access shall be restricted according to least privilege and periodically reviewed

title: National Data Residency
description: Sensitive regulated data shall be stored and processed within the Kingdom unless formally authorized otherwise

title: Encryption of Sensitive Data
description: Sensitive information shall be protected using approved cryptographic mechanisms at rest and in transit

title: Security Event Logging
description: Security events shall be logged monitored protected from tampering and retained for investigation

title: Arabic Security Reporting
description: Audit and compliance evidence required by national authorities shall be available in Arabic when requested

title: National Cybersecurity Reporting
description: Material cybersecurity incidents shall be reported to the competent national cybersecurity authority within mandated timelines

title: Cybersecurity Continuity
description: Cybersecurity continuity and recovery procedures shall be tested periodically

title: Supplier Security Requirements
description: Cybersecurity requirements shall be incorporated into contracts with external service providers

title: Local Cloud Hosting
description: Regulated workloads shall use approved hosting locations and local cloud regions when required by national policy

title: Vulnerability Remediation
description: Vulnerabilities shall be identified prioritized remediated and tracked according to risk
